messages:
deploy-bot: Started canary rollout for release v2.14.0 -> 10% traffic to canary. changelist: https://internal/rels/v2.14.0 :rocket:
alice.k: Copy. I'll watch p95 + 5xx on the SLO dashboard. @sre-oncall can you standby for alerts? :eyes:
ben_p: Can you also pin the canary to GPU pool-3 please? Last time pool-1 had noisy neighbors.
carla: Observability heads-up: embed-service p95 up ~120ms and 5xx rate from 0.2% -> 0.7% over the last 2m, small spike. Posting graph in #eng-dashboard.
miriam: Checking logs, seeing a couple OOM retries on rtm-05 around the same time. stack: prefix-cache lookup -> checkpoint write. Might be unrelated but worth verifying.
sre-oncall: Got alert deploy-high-5xx firing for embed-service x2. Investigating traces. No customer-facing incidents reported yet.
deploy-bot: Canary at 10% complete (10m). Snapshot: p50 +20ms, p95 +120ms, 5xx +0.5ppt. No automatic rollback triggered (threshold 1.5ppt).
alice.k: Recommendation: hold ramp for another 10m while SRE digs into the OOMs and we probe cache behavior. 
ben_p: Agree, hold at 10%. I'll also add a manual pin to quantized-model-v2 as a fallback in case errors persist.
carla: If cache misses are the cause we can try a short TTL bump for prefix-cache to reduce churn. Quick mitigation:
```
POST /admin/cache/ttl
{"service": "prefix-cache", "ttl_seconds": 900}
```
Can someone run this?
sre-oncall: Running the TTL bump now against canary nodes. curl -X POST https://infra-admin/prefix-cache/ttl -d '{"ttl_seconds":900}' :white_check_mark:
miriam: After TTL bump traces show reduced cache-miss tail. p95 trending down in the last 3m. OOMs on rtm-05 haven't recurred.
carla: Good sign. I've also applied a soft pin: model fallback -> quantized-model-v2 on canary if token-generation error >= 0.5%.
deploy-bot: Noted: soft-fallback configured. Canary held at 10% by request from @alice.k.
alice.k: Thanks everyone. If p95 and 5xx are back to baseline in 10m, proceed to 25% ramp.
(10 minutes pass)
carla: p95 stabilized to +30ms (baseline +10ms), 5xx back to 0.25%. No new alerts.
sre-oncall: Verified alerts cleared and noise subsided. No action items on SRE side.
ben_p: Starting manual ramp to 25% now. deploy-bot can you note the manual step in the deploy log?
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Moving canary to 25% traffic. Logged by ben_p.
alice.k: No customer-facing errors seen, no rollback needed. Will keep monitoring for the next 30m then continue roll-forward if stable.
miriam: Adding a note to release notes draft about the cache-TTL bump and fallback pin so support knows what we changed.
carla: TL;DR: Held at 10%, bumped prefix-cache TTL, soft model fallback pinned, ramp continued to 25% after metrics normalized.
alice.k: Final: roll-forward. Will update release thread with summary and the links to the SLO snapshots and the CLI commands used. Thanks :slightly_smiling_face:
